title: Valmiki Ramayana — Kishkindha Kanda
source_owner: Ralph T. H. Griffith translation (1870-1874) via Project Gutenberg; Sanskrit companion-only
revision_note: P1 Starter canonical ingestion per RAMAYANA_CANONICAL_SOURCE_PLAN.md Stage 2: Griffith public domain translation, Sanskrit companion-only.

content.sanskrit:
सौमित्रे शोभते पम्पा वैदूर्यविमलोदका ।
फुल्लपद्मोत्पलवती श्लक्ष्णवालुकसंवृता ॥
content.transliteration:
saumitre śobhate pampā vaidūryavimalodakā |
phullapadmotpalavatī ślakṣṇavālukasaṃvṛtā ||
content.text: Behold, O Saumitri, how beautiful shines Lake Pampa with water clear as lapis lazuli, adorned with blooming lotuses and water-lilies, and bordered by soft white sands.
content.translation: Behold, O Saumitri, how beautiful shines Lake Pampa with water clear as lapis lazuli, adorned with blooming lotuses and water-lilies, and bordered by soft white sands.
content.provenance: Griffith (1870-1874), Book IV, Canto I. Project Gutenberg #51540 (public domain). Sanskrit companion-only.

content.sanskrit:
नूनं व्याकरणं कृत्स्नमनेन बहुधा श्रुतम् ।
बहु व्याहरतानेन न किञ्चिदपशब्दितम् ॥
content.transliteration:
nūnaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ kṛtsnamanena bahudhā śrutam |
bahu vyāharatānena na kiñcidapaśabditam ||
content.text: Assuredly, the entire science of grammar has been mastered by him in many ways; for though he has spoken at great length, not a single flawed word has escaped his lips.
content.translation: Assuredly, the entire science of grammar has been mastered by him in many ways; for though he has spoken at great length, not a single flawed word has escaped his lips.
content.provenance: Griffith (1870-1874), Book IV, Canto IV. Project Gutenberg #51540 (public domain). Sanskrit companion-only.

content.sanskrit:
ततोऽग्निं दीप्यमानं तौ चक्रतुश्च प्रदक्षिणम् ।
सुग्रीवो राघवश्चैव वयस्यत्वमुपागतौ ॥
content.transliteration:
tato'gniṃ dīpyamānaṃ tau cakratuśca pradakṣiṇam |
sugrīvo rāghavaścaiva vayasyatvamupāgatau ||
content.text: Then circumambulating the blazing fire with reverence, both Sugriva and Raghava entered into sacred friendship and unbroken alliance.
content.translation: Then circumambulating the blazing fire with reverence, both Sugriva and Raghava entered into sacred friendship and unbroken alliance.
content.provenance: Griffith (1870-1874), Book IV, Canto V. Project Gutenberg #51540 (public domain). Sanskrit companion-only.

content.sanskrit:
धर्मेण च समायुक्तः कृतवानस्मि विक्रमम् ।
नास्मासु युज्यते दोषः सतां मार्गे व्यवस्थिते ॥
content.transliteration:
dharmeṇa ca samāyuktaḥ kṛtavānasmi vikramam |
nāsmāsu yujyate doṣaḥ satāṃ mārge vyavasthite ||
content.text: Actuated by righteousness have I exerted this prowess; no fault attaches to us who stand established upon the path of the noble.
content.translation: Actuated by righteousness have I exerted this prowess; no fault attaches to us who stand established upon the path of the noble.
content.provenance: Griffith (1870-1874), Book IV, Canto XVIII. Project Gutenberg #51540 (public domain). Sanskrit companion-only.
